extracted.name: Lemongrass gimlet
extracted.description: Lemongrass adds an aromatic dimension to this classic sweet and sour gin cocktail
instruction_lines: For the sugar syrup, put the lemongrass and caster sugar in a small pan over a medium heat. Pour over 50ml water. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 5 mins until thickened slightly. Remove from the heat and leave to cool completely and infuse.
Pour the cooled syrup into a cocktail shaker, including the lemongrass chunks. Add the lime juice, gin and a handful of ice. Shake until the outside of the cocktail shaker feels cold.
Strain into chilled glasses filled with ice. Garnish with a lime slice.
